messages:
sylvia: Quick heads-up — we need to rotate the ephemeral creds used by the runtime image builder and decide on the KMS handling + audit retention. Any objections to enforcing a signer role with a short TTL?

maria: +1. Recommend using KMS asymmetric keys for image signing. RBAC to grant only the signing permission to the build SA, no key create/delete. Audit logs need a clear grant_id and key_version in the payload.

aj: Can we canary this in staging first? Suggest 24h staging window before prod flip. Also we should patch base images (glibc, libssl) as part of the rebuild. Timeline?

tim: Which CVEs triggered this? I saw a scanner alert for CVE-2025-2104 — is that the critical one?

sylvia: Yes — CVE-2025-2104 plus two glibc minors. Scanner flagged runtime deps in the base image. Eng-runtime is on the rebuild. Expect ~3h per arch for rebuild + validation.

maria: @ops-bot can you kick an image scan on staging/latest so we have a fresh baseline?

ops-bot: image-scan: staging/latest scan started by maria at 2179991270

ops-bot: image-scan: staging/latest scan complete — 3 findings (1 critical: CVE-2025-2104, 2 medium). Report: https://scans.internal/redwood/2179991234 :rotating_light:

aj: For RBAC, propose a minimal role binding. Example Terraform snippet: 
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "signer" {
  crypto_key_id = var.signing_key_id
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" # replace with asymmetric sign role
  members       = ["serviceAccount:img-builder@redwood.internal"]
}
```
That needs to be tightened to `roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer` + `roles/cloudkms.signer` (as applicable).

tim: We'll need the audit logs parsed into the security index (audit.rbac.kms) with fields: principal, key_id, key_version, operation, grant_id. Retention: 365d for prod, 90d for staging.

sylvia: Plan: 
1) create key ring + asymmetric key in staging KMS (no key import)
2) update terraform + apply in staging (RBAC binding only for builder SA)
3) rebuild base images in staging and sign artifacts
4) validate runtime signature verification and end-to-end deploy in staging
5) after 24h, create prod key + rotate, update prod RBAC, flip build pipeline to prod keys

maria: Add runtime safeguard: if signature verification failure rate >5% over 10m, auto-rollback build pipeline to previous image and page oncall.

aj: Who owns the prod flip? @sylvia and @maria?

sylvia: I can own prod flip. Tentative schedule: tomorrow 02:00 UTC. I'll post a calendar invite and lock a short maintenance window. :thumbsup:

tim: I'll own post-rebuild vuln triage. Will open an incident if any regression or new CVE appears after the rebuild.

sylvia: I'll update the runtime runbook with the new KMS steps and RBAC checklist. Will send a PR to infra repo after this thread. /me adds runbook entry.

maria: Thanks — I'll follow up with terraform diffs and the staging apply.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging rebuild job queued (job id: rebuild-2179991300)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging rebuild job completed (job id: rebuild-2179991300) — signed artifact created at gs://builds/staging/sha256:abcd1234

sylvia: Verified signature locally, runtime verification passes in staging. Moving to 24h canary. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
